line: Building something for humanity is what I care about most.

items.title: HOPE Foundation
items.what: A Tamil Nadu non-profit with 40+ members, raising awareness about sustainable menstruation. Our suSTAIN campaign educated 1M+ women, and we raised funds to give 1K+ women menstrual kits, with a gender-inclusive approach.

items.title: She Group
items.what: A social-tech startup helping married women become financially independent. We won a USD 4K grant to build a digital capability network and mentored women into jobs.

items.title: Mkono
items.what: A Canadian non-profit giving interest-free loans and mentorship to Kenyan entrepreneurs. I mentor an agri-tech founder on business development and digital tools.

items.title: Bain Social Impact & Women at Bain
items.what: Volunteering alongside client work, plus the Bangalore culture team.

items.title: Policy in Action Fellow, YLAC
items.what: Drafted a policy on regulating crypto assets for Dr. Amar Patnaik, MP, to present in the Indian Parliament.

items.title: Oxford Policy Advisory Group
items.what: Drafted a policy to strengthen Tamil Nadu's e-Governance framework.

items.title: Institute Cultural Affairs Secretary, IIT Madras
items.what: The first woman in 64 years to lead the cultural sphere. Led Saarang, India's largest student-run fest (~800 coordinators, 100K+ footfall), hosted the Inter-IIT Cultural Meet (3K+ participants), and raised USD 250K+ from alumni for a Central Cultural Building.
